meta_data.base_class: Modify a <public transportation> booking, including changing flight number, cabin class, and extra baggage, and handling payment balance updates if necessary - refers to types of public transport requiring scheduled booking and class differentiation.

user_id.description: The ID of the user making the <class> modification.

reservation_id.description: The reservation ID of the <class> booking to be modified.

new_schedule_no.description: The new schedule number to change to.

new_cabin.description: The new cabin class of the <class> to change to. (e.g., economy class, business class)

extra_baggage.description: The number of additional checked baggage items to add.

new_payment_method.description: Payment method for any additional charges. One of: 'cash', 'bank'.

cancellation_policy_agreement.description: Indicates whether the user agrees to the cancellation and modification policy of the <class>.

modification_reason.description: The reason provided by the user for modifying the <class> reservation.

notification_preference.description: Preferred method of notification for updates related to the <class> modification, should be one of: 'email', 'SMS', 'app notification'.

loyalty_program_id.description: The user's loyalty program ID associated with the <class> reservation for potential benefits or discounts.
